subject: Creating conditional tabs on the client side - 3 tries, no luck :-)

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Creating conditional tabs on the client side - 3 tries, no luck :-)
parts:
In my side panel I show a multi-list.  If the user selects a single item, then on the right I show a graph and a table.

If the user-selects exactly two, then a second graph is available.  I want to show these as two tabs, one for "this data" and one for "compare these two".

If the user doesn't select a second run, I would like the second tab to be disabled, either not there at all, or greyed out and not clickable.

I have implemented such conditional tabs by using server-side reactiveUI, but I'd prefer to generate them client side using logic like in conditionalPanel.

However, adding a conditionalPanel as a child of tabset fails (not unexpectedly). 

It is possible to add conditional logic to tabPanel:

tabPanel("Ratio", `data-display-if`="input.selection.length == 2",

Which works fine, except that:

 * the Tab header is still visible and clickable and appears 'enabled' to the user. 
 * when clicked it just shows blankness (if only one item is selected).

Also, reactivePlot functions mentioned in the second tab are invoked (even though they are not displayed and if dynamicGraphics is not set there is no possible rendering for them.  I think this is a rather different issue.

What do you recommend?  Perhaps tabSetPanel can be changed to have the tab header LI inherit the condition of the child, if there is one?

-Alex

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Creating conditional tabs on the client side - 3 tries, no luck :-)
parts:
The tab headers are just not designed to be conditional at all, sorry. Certainly they could be, we just didn't design them that way. You could probably do this with a little JS though.

  1. Make the tabsetPanel/tabPanel as normal
  2. Give the tabsetPanel an id attribute (assume "tabs" for this example)
  3. Put a conditionalPanel inside the tabPanel, including an id attribute on the conditionalPanel with a unique value (assume "graph2" for the below example)
  4. Include the following snippet in your ui.R (change tabIndex to be the zero-based tab number, for example tab #2 would be tabIndex=1, tab #3 would be tabIndex=2):
tags$head(tags$script(HTML('
var tabIndex = 1;
$(document).on("shown", "#graph2", function() {
  $("#tabs>li").get(tabIndex).show();
});
$(document).on("hidden", "#graph2", function() {
  $("#tabs>li").get(tabIndex).hide();
});
')))

I haven't actually tried this code but it should instruct the tab button to show when graph2 becomes available and hide when graph2 goes away. If it doesn't work, please send a code sample if possible. Thanks!
